OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_DURATION_PERIOD.description: The period of time to await between two runs of the connector, as an ISO 8601 duration (e.g. `PT1H` for one hour). Must be greater than zero: the connector runs continuously and is not meant to run once and exit.

CVELISTV5_REPO_URL.description: Upstream git repository. Override only if you mirror cvelistV5 internally.

CVELISTV5_REPO_BRANCH.description: Branch of the upstream git repository to follow.

CVELISTV5_LOCAL_PATH.description: Local path where the clone is kept. Must be writable by the connector; mount a volume there to keep the clone across restarts.

CVELISTV5_HISTORY_START_YEAR.description: Oldest year of CVE records to import on the initial run (minimum 1999; a lower value falls back to the default).
